questions_and_answers.question_text: Andreas Schuster ging zum amerikanischen Generalkonsulat, um ein Visum zu beantragen.

answers.answer_text: Andreas Schuster went to the American Consulate General to apply for a visa.

questions_and_answers.question_text: Man hatte ihm gesagt, dass er sich an einen der Konsuln wenden sollte.

answers.answer_text: He had been told that he was to go to one of the consuls.

questions_and_answers.question_text: Er stellte sich Vize-Konsul Thompson vor, der ihn bat, Platz zu nehmen.

answers.answer_text: He introduced himself to Vice-Consul Thompson who asked him to sit down.

questions_and_answers.question_text: Schuster war vor drei Monaten aus der Ostzone gekommen und wollte sich in Amerika eine neue Existenz aufbauen.

answers.answer_text: Schuster had come from the Eastern Zone three months ago and wanted to build up a new life for himself in America.

questions_and_answers.question_text: Er hatte einen Onkel in den Staaten, der für ihn bürgen wollte.

answers.answer_text: He had an uncle in the States who was willing to act as a sponsor for him.

questions_and_answers.question_text: Vize-Konsul Thompson holte ein Formular und nahm Schusters Personalien auf.

answers.answer_text: Vice-Consul Thompson got a form and noted down Schuster's name and address and other personal particulars.

questions_and_answers.question_text: Thompson fragte Schuster auch nach seinem Familienstand.

answers.answer_text: Thompson asked Schuster about his family status too.

questions_and_answers.question_text: Schuster war ledig.

answers.answer_text: Schuster was single.

questions_and_answers.question_text: Vize-Konsul Thompson wollte auch wissen, ob der Antragsteller vorbestraft war und ob er Mitglied einer politischen Partei war.

answers.answer_text: Vice-Consul Thompson also had to know whether the applicant had ever been convicted of a crime and whether he was a member of a political party.

questions_and_answers.question_text: Er war nicht vorbestraft.

answers.answer_text: He had not been previously convicted.

questions_and_answers.question_text: Als Junge war er Mitglied der FDJ und später Kandidat der SED gewesen.

answers.answer_text: As a boy he had been a member of the Free German Youth and later a probational party member in the Socialist Unity Party.

questions_and_answers.question_text: Er war nur Kandidat geworden, um keine Schwierigkeiten mit seinem Geschäft zu bekommen.

answers.answer_text: He had only become a probational party member in order not to get into any trouble with his business.

questions_and_answers.question_text: Er hatte aber nie einen Funktionärsposten bekleidet.

answers.answer_text: He had never occupied a position as a party official however.

questions_and_answers.question_text: Sein Betrieb war nun VEB geworden, und Schuster war bei Nacht und Nebel geflohen.

answers.answer_text: His business had now become a state-controlled enterprise, and Schuster had fled in the black of night.

questions_and_answers.question_text: Er wäre schon eher geflohen, wenn er nicht die Hoffnung gehabt hätte, dass sich die Zustände ändern würden.

answers.answer_text: He would have run away before that if he hadn't had hopes that conditions would change.

questions_and_answers.question_text: Er stand nicht mehr mit Mitgliedern der FDJ oder SED in Verbindung, und er hatte keine Angehörigen in der Zone.

answers.answer_text: He was no longer in contact with members of the Free German Youth or Socialist Unity party, and he had no immediate relatives in the Eastern Zone.

questions_and_answers.question_text: Vize-Konsul Thompson wollte Schusters Strafregisterauszug anfordern.

answers.answer_text: Vice-Consul Thompson wanted to send for the summary of Schuster's record of court convictions.

questions_and_answers.question_text: Schuster war damit einverstanden.

answers.answer_text: Schuster was willing for that to be done.

questions_and_answers.question_text: Er brauchte auch sein polizeiliches Führungszeugnis, einen gültigen Reisepass, seinen Bürgschaftsbrief, vier Photos und seine Geburtsurkunde.

answers.answer_text: He also needed his record of police court actions, a valid passport, his letter of sponsorship, four photographs and his birth certificate.

questions_and_answers.question_text: Sobald er alle Papiere beisammen hatte, sollte er das Konsulat benachrichtigen.

answers.answer_text: As soon as he had all the papers together he was to notify the Consulate.

questions_and_answers.question_text: Wie lange es dauern würde, bis er auswandern könnte, wusste Vize-Konsul Thompson nicht.

answers.answer_text: How long it would be before he could emigrate Vice-Consul Thompson didn't know.

questions_and_answers.question_text: Es würde einige Zeit in Anspruch nehmen, um die nötigen Auskünfte einzuziehen.

answers.answer_text: It would take some time to collect the necessary information.

questions_and_answers.question_text: Schuster sollte sich später von einem deutschen Arzt impfen lassen und bevor er sein Visum bekommen würde, würde er sich im Generalkonsulat untersuchen und röntgen lassen müssen.

answers.answer_text: Schuster was supposed to have his vaccination done later on by a German doctor, and before he would get his visa he would have to be examined and x-rayed at the Consulate General.
